description: Gisborne and Hawke's Bay - Cyclone Gabrielle River Flood LiDAR Index Tiles (2023) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Elevation. This layer contains the Index Tiles for LiDAR data in Gisborne and Hawke's Bay following Cyclone Gabrielle, captured from 26 February to 15 March 2023. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Elevation. Its tags are Elevation, LiDAR, New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2023-10-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
